purpose: one bounded b1s probe of the unified Update qualification on a GitHub-hosted macOS arm64 runner; test equipment, not product

product.rule: C stays apart from the execution commit E: E has exactly one parent, C, and only adds the public inventory (ci-macos-probe/SHA256SUMS, every file it lists, .github/workflows/qualification-update-macos.yml)

equipment.change: facts and obs record TCP listeners of the actual uid (lsof -u "$(/usr/bin/id -u)") instead of -u anka (recorders only); localfn for the site kind runs the helper with the serving process's observed package-loading environment from its procwatch snapshot, UNKNOWN when that is not recorded in plain; comment-only hygiene of earlier lab identifiers
docstring-only hygiene of earlier lab identifiers (the docstring is also its usage text)
comment-only hygiene; the lab-mode commit message (code, unused by commit mode) is unchanged

equipment_patch.form: diff -u of qb1.sh's behaviour change: the original with the comment-only hygiene applied against the copy; the hygiene itself is not reproduced (the digests above pin each original and copy); procwatch.py, mkbundle.sh and capture.py have no behaviour change

placement.ci-macos-probe/: exactly SHA256SUMS and the files it lists, byte-identical; nothing else of a working copy

offline_checks_by_author: syntax parses and inert consumer checks of extracted decision code with stubbed producers; no probe, product, app, network, CI or native execution. Their evidence is local and not part of this inventory.
